threads.body: [General] `startWeaverValidation` is called after `startTarget`, whereas `TomcatTest` and `JvmTest` call it before. `startWeaverValidation` is what calls `otlpServer.setForwardEndpoint(...)`, so with this ordering the target is already exporting (5s interval) before forwarding is wired up — the first export batches are dropped, and `forwardStub` gets assigned from the test thread while the Armeria gRPC thread may already be reading it. Nothing here needs the later position since `jettyMajorVersion` is known up front, so this block can move above `startTarget(container)`.

Now that this file is the canonical list of jetty metrics, it's worth noticing that `library/jetty.md` has drifted from what is actually emitted. The doc lists `jetty.io.select.count` in both tables, but the rule and this registry both use `jetty.select.count`. The doc also gives `jetty.session.duration.sum` the unit `{session}` where it is really `s`. Could you fix those two in `jetty.md` as part of this PR so the doc and the registry agree?

threads.body: #19406 removed this header from the other model files when it bumped weaver to `v0.25.1`, and its renovate rule only matches `otel/weaver:` in Java files, so this `v0.24.2` pin won't get updated. Looks like the merge just left this copy behind. Worth dropping this line and the blank one below.

`queueSize` counts queued jobs, not threads — this inherits `{thread}` from the group-level unit in the rule file. Camel's equivalent uses `{task}`. Worth fixing before the registry locks it in (rule, doc table and test assertion too).
